name: Season 1
overview: In Chang'an City, a mysterious herb called Black Tea causes a stir, coinciding with a string of missing bride cases. General Lingfeng of the Jin Wu guards is tasked with uncovering the truth. Along the way, he encounters Su Wuming, a sharp detective and disciple of Di Renjie. Together, they unravel a web of supernatural mysteries and dark conspiracies threatening the city.
